name: ps-spec
description: Drive a software project from an idea or a PRD to shipped, tested, documented features with OpenSpec, one epic per change. PRD.md + ARCHITECTURE.md → EPICS.md with user stories → one OpenSpec change per epic (proposal, specs, design, tasks, test-plan) → git branch → code with observability built in → test plan with interactive debugging → feature doc → archive + merge. Four human checkpoints (PRD, epics, plan, validate) with an autonomous coding loop between them; a rules guard hook makes sure openspec config.yaml rules reach the model before every artifact is written; secure-coding rule packs (OWASP 2025, MCP/AI/agent/RAG, per-language and per-framework) installed at init.
